facts.fact: Open Access Data Centres, part of Wiocc, completed purchase of seven NTT Data facilities on 31 December 2025 in a sale-and-leaseback adding over 25MW, with sites in Bloemfontein, Cape Town, East London, Gqeberha, Durban and Johannesburg.
Teraco, owned by Digital Realty, is described as a South African data centre competitor with close to 190MW of IT load (no date given; article date used).
